knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A hidden gap is harbourage that cleaning cannot reach. Sealing or raising equipment removes that space.
Clearance allows inspection and cleaning, and removes shelter. The 45 cm figure is the US source's rule of thumb.
Overgrown vegetation and debris piles give shelter. The other options describe the controls the source recommends.

practicalCriteria: Learner walks a zone and records at least three harbourage or exclusion findings with location (pass: findings recorded correctly).
Learner moves a stock item off the floor onto a pallet or rack in a safe way (pass: clearance and lifting method observed).
Learner reports a door or pipe gap to the responsible person (pass: report made with location and time).
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Walk record from the practical zone
Report note to the responsible person
Observer checklist for lifting and stock placement
stopWorkCriteria: An opening turns up in a food zone while food is being handled.
A structural repair is needed and only a licensed trade may carry it out.
A lift would exceed the worker's safe capacity or the aid provided.
Outdoor work is being done near traffic or an unsafe drain without controls.
